per_criterion.name: AESTHETICS
per_criterion.note: The design is exceptionally clean and modern, utilizing a white space-heavy layout that feels professional. The integration of soft pastel colors for the KPI icons (blue, purple, yellow, green) adds visual interest without cluttering the interface. The use of rounded corners and subtle shadows creates a high-fidelity look.

per_criterion.name: LEARNABILITY
per_criterion.note: The layout strictly follows standard dashboard patterns. The header with the 'Last 30 days' toggle and the 4-column KPI card grid are instantly recognizable. A user would immediately understand which metrics are being displayed and how to adjust the time frame.

per_criterion.name: EFFICIENCY
per_criterion.note: The information is easy to scan with the large typography on the KPI values. However, the cards contain significant amounts of empty vertical space at the bottom, which lowers the information density slightly. The wide gap between the search bar and the time filter in the header also breaks the visual flow slightly.

per_criterion.name: USABILITY
per_criterion.note: Touch targets (buttons, cards) are appropriately sized. Contrast for the primary text and metric values is high against the white background. The color-coded icons assist in quick differentiation of the metrics.

per_criterion.name: OVERALL
per_criterion.note: This is a shippable, high-quality design. It hits the balance between 'minimal' and 'informative' perfectly for an analytics overview. The styling is consistent and refined.

top_3_fixes: Reduce the height of the KPI cards to remove the excessive empty white space at the bottom of each card.
Tighten the header layout by grouping the time-filter button and notification icons closer to the search bar to improve the use of the middle section.
Ensure the green 'vs last month' text in the cards meets WCAG AA contrast standards, as the small green text appears faint.

per_criterion.name: AESTHETICS
per_criterion.note: The design is fundamentally broken. The top-left of the heading is clipped off (shows 'tart building'). The pricing tiers are misaligned, with the middle card floating above the others. The layout looks like an unstyled wireframe or a rendering bug with grey blocks and awkward spacing.

per_criterion.name: LEARNABILITY
per_criterion.note: The structure is recognizable as a pricing page, but the visual confusion (the floating badge in the middle card, the cut-off text) makes it hard to parse the 'Scale' tier clearly. The button inside the middle card is an empty box, making its purpose unclear.

per_criterion.name: EFFICIENCY
per_criterion.note: Significant wasted space and visual noise. The middle column is misaligned with the side columns, creating an inefficient grid. The user has to work to figure out which elements belong to which tier due to the layout errors.

per_criterion.name: USABILITY
per_criterion.note: Severe usability failures. The heading is cut off. There is an empty button with no text in the 'Scale' card. The 'Starter' card's button overlaps with a floating grey shape. The misalignment of cards makes it hard to associate features with prices.

per_criterion.name: OVERALL
per_criterion.note: This is not shippable. It looks like a glitched screenshot or a failed draft. The text clipping and floating elements indicate a lack of basic layout validation.

strings_missing: Scale card has an empty button box

top_3_fixes: Fix the heading text so it is fully visible and not clipped on the left.
Align the three pricing cards (Starter, Scale, Enterprise) into a uniform grid with consistent heights and positions.
Add a label to the empty button in the 'Scale' tier and remove the floating/overlapping grey boxes that break the layout.

per_criterion.name: AESTHETICS
per_criterion.note: The dark theme provides a modern, cohesive look. The large typography for the '404' headline is impactful, and the blue accent color for the CTA creates a clear visual hierarchy.

per_criterion.name: LEARNABILITY
per_criterion.note: The layout strictly follows standard patterns for error pages: headline, explanatory text, search input, and a clear call to action. It is instantly understandable.

per_criterion.name: EFFICIENCY
per_criterion.note: The interface is uncluttered. The 'Go Home' button and search box are the primary actions, and their placement minimizes the cognitive load on the user.

per_criterion.name: USABILITY
per_criterion.note: Touch targets are adequately sized. However, the text contrast ratio for the secondary 'Go Home' link in the right-hand panel and the placeholder text in the search bar is relatively low, which may struggle to meet WCAG AA standards.

per_criterion.name: OVERALL
per_criterion.note: A very strong, professional design that effectively communicates the error and offers clear next steps. The inclusion of a secondary navigation (top-right) adds utility without being distracting.
